metadataRaw.title: How to Get Full Back Pain Relief in 30 SECONDS
metadataRaw.description:
If you're dealing with upper, middle, and lower back pains, aches, and muscle tightness... this is a video for you!

Dr. Rowe shows 4 easy exercises that can give full back pain relief within 30 seconds. 

All of the exercises will hit the back (and muscles) just a little different. Make sure to go through them all and use what gives you the most relief.

As a bonus, all of these exercises can be done at home, require no equipment, and may give whole back pain and tightness relief within 30 SECONDS.

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
0:43 The 'Once Daily' Exercise
3:45 Psoas Cobra
5:53 Doorway Stretch
9:29 Full Back Strengthening Bridge
